# smart-base-translations

The gettext side of smart-base's own strings, one directory per target locale: today the `processes/` templates of the BPMN diagrams this instance draws. Moved here from cat-harness/translations/ on the owner's ruling of 2026-10-04, "move things to semantically appropriate place" (bean riit): a diagram's templates sit with the instance that draws it.

Part of [SMART Base](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-base-translations`, holding `translation-sources`.
